basic_info.description: This spacious, light-filled 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers the space and flexibility families crave in the heart of the Sunset. Built in 2001, the three-level layout blends modern comfort with everyday convenience.    The main level features an open living and dining area with abundant natural light, a spacious kitchen, covered balcony, and powder room. Upstairs, two ensuite bedrooms provide peaceful retreats, including a primary suite with walk-in closet and spa-like bath.    The lower level adds versatility with two bedrooms, a full bath, laundry room, and two outdoor spaces perfect for guests, home office, or multigenerational living. A two-car garage plus extra storage makes room for bikes, sports gear, and more.    Just minutes from Golden Gate Park, Irving & Noriega shops and cafes, and public transit, this home balances city convenience with the comfort of space. Many will appreciate proximity to top schools, green spaces, and Ocean Beach. Here you'll find more than a house...you'll find a place to grow, gather, and thrive.
